2026-10-07PPCPublic Servants Disclosure Protection ActAppointment of a member and Chairperson of the Public Servants Disclosure Protection Tribunal Appointment of Love Saint-Fleur of Montréal, Quebec to be a member of the Public Servants Disclosure Protection Tribunal, for a term ending on November 29, 2026, and to be a Chairperson of the Public Servants Disclosure Protection Tribunal, to hold office during pleasure for a term of five years, effective November 30, 2026.N/A
